release_notes_md:
## v0.2.0 — Licensing Overhaul (Phase 3 go-live)

This is a major licensing update. License files no longer carry any
customer identity, activation can now be done online with a short key,
and support-plan status governs which upgrades you can install. The
update is delivered the usual way and works on both internet-connected
and air-gapped deployments.

### What's new

- **Online activation.** On a connected deployment you can now activate
  by typing a 16-character license key on the License page — no file
  exchange needed. Offline/air-gapped deployments keep the existing
  download-system-info → receive-license-file flow, auto-selected when
  the licensing server isn't reachable.
- **Automatic daily refresh.** Connected deployments check in once a day
  to pick up renewals, capacity changes, and revocations automatically.
  This is a no-op on air-gapped systems and never downgrades a working
  license when the server is unreachable.
- **Hardware migration request.** Move a license to new hardware from the
  License page. Within your migration allowance it rebinds immediately;
  beyond it, the request is routed to the vendor for approval.
- **Support-plan gating on updates.** Patch releases install on any active
  license. Minor and major upgrades require an active support plan; a
  lapsed plan still runs and still takes patches, and rollbacks are always
  allowed.
- **Privacy: no identity in license files.** License artifacts no longer
  contain customer name or email, so backups, logs, and support
  attachments don't leak identity.
- **Ingest/writes pause on an expired license.** When a license expires,
  event ingest stops within ~60s and the portal goes read-only until a
  valid license is in place. Existing data is untouched.
- **Refreshed License page** with clear Not-activated / Activating /
  Activated states and per-license actions.

### Upgrade notes

- Existing license files keep working — they're still recognized after
  the upgrade. Connected deployments will refresh automatically; if the
  vendor has issued you a new key, enter it on the License page.
- Self-service trials have been removed. New deployments go straight to
  activation after setup.
- Air-gapped deployments are fully supported via the offline activation
  flow; none of the online features are required.
